android.desc: Flight Pass is your boarding pass wallet and travel companion. Scan every boarding pass into one place, get notified when your flight and gate are called, show your QR code at the gate - even with no signal - and see every trip you have flown on a 3D globe. IMPORT ANY BOARDING PASS • Scan a PDF boarding pass - the one your airline emails after online check-in • Import a screenshot or photo (JPEG, PNG) of your mobile boarding pass • Scan a paper pass printed at the airport check-in desk and go paperless • Open or share a .pkpass / passbook file straight into the app • Passbook passes also bring boarding time, terminal, gate and gate closing time • Import from any app through the Android share sheet, in one tap BOARD WITHOUT STRESS • Tap the notification to open a large, high-contrast boarding pass QR code • Screen brightness is raised automatically so any gate scanner reads it first try • Multi-leg trips are laid out one card per flight, with connections in order • TSA PreCheck passes are detected and show the TSA Pre indicator • Seat, cabin class, sequence number and frequent flyer number at a glance FLIGHT ALERTS AND LIVE STATUS • Reminders before departure, with the terminal and gate when they are published • Get told when your departure time moves, so a delay never surprises you • A sticky notification a few hours before take-off for instant access to your pass • Flight status on the home screen: on time, delayed, boarding, departed HOME SCREEN WIDGET • Your next flight at a glance, in three sizes • Route, departure time, gate and status without opening the app YOUR FLIGHTS ON A 3D GLOBE • Every route you have flown, drawn on an interactive 3D globe: turn it, zoom in, tap a route or an airport • Replay your travels: watch your flights take off one after the other as the miles add up • Share a picture of your globe and stats with friends YOUR TRAVEL STATS • Distance flown, time in the air, airports visited, for all time, this year or this month • Longest and shortest flights, most flown route, busiest day and month • Top airlines, airports and aircraft, cabin class, window or aisle, on-time record WORKS OFFLINE, STAYS PRIVATE • Every boarding pass is stored locally on your device • No account, no sign-up, no network needed at the airport • Archive a pass you are done with to keep your upcoming trips list clean • Dark mode to save battery on OLED screens and g
